text.en: ConvNeXts is row 8 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the Vision area.
text.zh: ConvNeXts 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 8 行，所属领域为“视觉”。

text.en: The annual table associates ConvNeXts with “A ConvNet for the 2020s”.
text.zh: 年度表把 ConvNeXts 与论文《A ConvNet for the 2020s》关联。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is “Zhuang Liu, Saining Xie”.
text.zh: “主要人物”字段依次列出 刘壮、谢赛宁；官方英文原文为“Zhuang Liu, Saining Xie”。

text.en: Zhuang Liu and Saining Xie, the two main contributors named by BenchCouncil, are respectively the first and last authors of the CVPR 2022 paper, and both researcher-controlled homepages list ConvNeXt.
text.zh: BenchCouncil 列出的两位主要人物刘壮和谢赛宁分别是 CVPR 2022 论文的第一作者与末位作者，两人的个人主页也都列出 ConvNeXt。

text.en: ConvNeXt progressively modernizes a ResNet with a contemporary training recipe, transformer-inspired stage ratios and stem, depthwise convolution, inverted bottlenecks, larger kernels, LayerNorm and GELU while remaining a pure ConvNet.
text.zh: ConvNeXt 逐步以现代训练方案、受 Transformer 启发的阶段比例与 stem、深度卷积、倒置瓶颈、更大卷积核、LayerNorm 和 GELU 改造 ResNet，同时始终保持纯卷积结构。

text.en: The paper reports 87.8% ImageNet top-1 accuracy and stronger COCO detection and ADE20K segmentation results than comparable Swin Transformers.
text.zh: 论文报告 87.8% 的 ImageNet top-1 准确率，并在 COCO 检测与 ADE20K 分割上超过可比的 Swin Transformer。
